title: ARS Storyboard Agent — Input
description: Validates the input shape consumed by the ARS Storyboard Agent v1.0. Per Storyboard Agent SPEC §2 + Cross-SPEC Consistency Review §3 (canonical names).

script.description: Script Agent v1.0 output object. Either successScript variant (consumed normally) OR errorEnvelope variant (Storyboard Agent must halt with script_not_success at Step 1). Polymorphism is intentional — schema-level acceptance of both lets the runtime branch run cleanly.

oneOf.description: successScript — required fields below; full validation against script-agent/output.schema.json successScript variant happens at runtime.
errorEnvelope — emitted by Script Agent when upstream validation failed. Storyboard Agent halts with script_not_success.

brief.description: Pass-through Brief Agent output (denormalized for self-containment). Storyboard reads do_not_say + visual_direction.no_buildings_rule from this object directly rather than re-deriving from script. Polymorphic accept matches script field — but in practice the orchestrator only passes successBrief here when script is also successScript.

prior_storyboards.description: Up to 5 most recent storyboard.json objects for this brand. Oldest first. Used for opener-shot rotation, camera-movement diversification, and color-grade variance.

production_constraints.description: Optional Mode A constraints — locations, talent, equipment tier, budget minutes, weather window.

mode_b_engine_profile.description: Required only when script.production_mode == 'B'. Specifies the AI video model the Storyboard targets so ai_render_plan can be tier-aware.

mode_c_reference_url.description: Required only when script.production_mode == 'C'. URL of the source reel whose style is being replicated.
